name: in.nebulatech/nebula
title: Nebula - AI-first B2B digital marketing, Mumbai
description: Ask Nebula (Mumbai) about AI-first B2B digital marketing: services, sectors, GEO/AEO Answers, blogs.

tools.name: nebula_get_overview
tools.description: Read-only summary of Nebula (org, founders, services, industries, frameworks, counts). Use this when you need a company snapshot; use nebula_search_knowledge instead for ranked queries, nebula_list_knowledge instead to browse titles/URLs, nebula_get_section instead for one exact path. Returns organization, people, services, industries, frameworks, counts, sections, guardrails, graphVersion.

tools.name: nebula_search_knowledge
tools.description: Read-only ranked keyword search across approved Nebula KB sections (compact records; blog hits are title/excerpt only). Use this when you have a query about Nebula knowledge; use nebula_list_knowledge instead to browse without ranking, nebula_get_section instead for one exact path, nebula_get_overview instead for a summary. For full-text search of blog article bodies use nebula_search_blog; for a full article use nebula_get_blog. Returns query, results[{path,score,record}], total, offset, limit, nextOffset.

query.description: Search words, e.g. "AI SEO for manufacturers"

offset.description: Number of ranked hits to skip (default 0)

tools.name: nebula_list_knowledge
tools.description: Read-only browse/enumerate of approved Nebula KB items (title, url, section, date when present). Use this when you want to page through a section or the full allowlist; use nebula_search_knowledge instead for ranked queries, nebula_get_section instead for full record content, nebula_get_overview instead for a summary. Returns items[{title,url,section,date?}], total, offset, limit, nextOffset.

section.description: Optional section id to list (one of: organization, people, services, industries, frameworks, research, externalAssets, pages, answers, caseStudies, blogs). Omit to list all approved sections.

tools.name: nebula_get_section
tools.description: Read-only fetch of one exact section or record by dotted path. Sections: organization, people, services, industries, frameworks, research, externalAssets, pages, answers, caseStudies, blogs. Use this when you know the path from search/list; use nebula_get_overview instead for a summary, nebula_search_knowledge instead to find paths, nebula_list_knowledge instead to browse titles. Returns path plus value, or for list sections: items, total, offset, limit, nextOffset. Reading one Answer ("answers.4") adds fullAnswer, its full body in Markdown; "caseStudies.0" returns one full case study. For full blog article bodies use nebula_get_blog (blogs here stay compact: title, url, excerpt, date). Examples: "services", "answers.4", "caseStudies.0", "organization.address".

offset.description: For list sections: first item index (default 0)

limit.description: For list sections: items per page (default 20)

tools.name: nebula_get_blog
tools.description: Read-only fetch of one active published English Nebula blog post as Markdown (full article body). Use this when you need the complete article after nebula_search_blog or nebula_list_knowledge (section "blogs"); use nebula_get_section instead for Answers, case studies, or services. Accepts slug, canonical URL (/post/...), or index from nebula_list_knowledge blogs (0-based). Old or redirected slugs resolve to the current live post (canonicalUrl of the replacement; response includes requestedSlug and redirectedFrom). Retired slugs return a clear retired message. Returns title, slug, canonicalUrl, publisher, datePublished, dateModified, language, excerpt, categories/tags when available, contentMarkdown, contentFormat. Only live published English posts; /ar/ posts return an error. If the JSON exceeds the size cap, contentMarkdown is paginated via contentOffset / nextContentOffset.

index.description: 0-based index into nebula_list_knowledge / nebula_get_section blogs (same order as the compact blogs list)

contentOffset.description: Character offset into contentMarkdown when continuing a truncated response (default 0)

tools.name: nebula_search_blog
tools.description: Read-only keyword search over the full text of active published English Nebula blog posts (not titles only). Use this when you need to discover which article to open with nebula_get_blog; use nebula_search_knowledge instead for the wider knowledge base. Ranking is deterministic term scoring (title > excerpt > body). Returns results[{title, slug, canonicalUrl, excerpt, matchedSnippet, datePublished, dateModified, score}], query, total. When the page is shortened to fit the size cap, truncated is true and nextOffset continues the ranked list. Arabic (/ar/) and excluded posts are never returned.

query.description: Search words or a short question, e.g. "AI SEO for manufacturing exporters"

offset.description: First result index when continuing a truncated page (default 0)
